notes: Verified from the official Cardless compare page on 2026-07-25. The page lists two cards; this entry is the lower-tier Signature card ($99 annual fee), distinct from the Infinite card ($499, us-first-cardless-qatar-infinite). Signature grants first-year Privilege Club Silver (oneworld Ruby) and earns 2 Qpoints for every 2,000 Avios; the Infinite grants Gold and a richer benefit set. Per-category Avios earn multipliers (Qatar Airways purchases, dining, everywhere else) are not exposed as machine-readable numbers on the official compare page (JS-rendered; headline states "up to 5x Avios"), so categories are left empty and the base rate is null. APR not shown on the compare page; the Rates & Fees PDF (legal.cardless.com/schumer/premium-99-qatar/rates_and_fees.pdf) is the official pricing document. No official card art was confidently identifiable for the Signature variant, so image is null.
